A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 32-page versions of FRUGAL. Their text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–G support reliable comparison; all scientific pages match visually.

before.justification: v2 reports original language-model pre-training and fine-tuning experiments in Sections 3, 6 and 7, with additional experiments and analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including C4 pre-training perplexities, GLUE results and commonsense-reasoning evaluations.

M1.justification: FRUGAL's gradient splitting, optimizer choices, projection and state-management procedures, and Algorithms 1–5 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain C4 pre-training, GLUE fine-tuning, eight-task commonsense-reasoning evaluation and the quadratic optimization example in Appendix D.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: AdamW, GaLore and BAdam in the main pre-training comparisons; LoRA and GaLore in fine-tuning; and AdaMeM, Fira and LDAdam in Appendix B.

E3.justification: Sections 6–7 and Appendix A retain the same model configurations, training durations, precision settings, ranks/densities, learning-rate searches and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The projection, optimizer, module-sensitivity and hyperparameter analyses are unchanged, including the ablations in Appendix A and momentum-reprojection example in Appendix D.

E5.justification: Both report means and standard deviations over three independent runs in Table 6 and five runs for Appendix D's toy example. Section 6.3's single-run disclosure is also unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted findings are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 2 retains FRUGAL's 130M perplexity of 18.60 at density 0.25, and Table 6 retains its rank-8 average of 86.7.

T1.justification: Assumption 5.1, Theorem 5.2, Appendix E's definitions, lemmas and proofs, and Appendix C's memory derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about full-rank memory-efficient updates, convergence guarantees, empirical performance and output-layer optimizer sensitivity.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and computational tradeoffs are unchanged. Appendix F retains the same limitations concerning 7B+ pre-training, language-model-only experiments and subspace-selection strategies.

D1.justification: Implementation settings in Appendix A, pseudocode in Appendix G and the code-availability footnote and link target are unchanged. The revised funding acknowledgement adds no reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B and the cited works are unchanged. The Kunstner et al. and Touvron et al. reference entries move across page boundaries without content changes.

P1.justification: The page 10 acknowledgement expands the funding description with grant agreement, date and subsidy details, and changes the author's visiting-research-assistant description to 'visited.' The arXiv version/date stamp also updates; other prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer acknowledgement shifts the Impact Statement and reflows references across pages 10–12. Figures, tables and appendix layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v3 adds administrative specificity to the acknowledgement but leaves the scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and limitations unchanged. The limited reference reflow has no material effect on readability or overall paper quality.
